data.name: Kishankumar
data.long_meaning: Kishankumar is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Kishan' meaning 'Lord Shiva' and 'Kumar' meaning 'manifestation' or 'youth'. This name holds significant spiritual significance in Hindu mythology, as Kishan represents the divine power and protectiveness of Lord Shiva.
